title: Symmetry and Round-Independent Trail Clustering
summary: A symmetry-based equivalence remains limited; tightening it or finding round-independent trail clustering not caused by symmetries is open.

formal_statement.body: Either strengthen the symmetry/eigenvector equivalence, or construct round-independent trail clustering not caused by symmetries.

scope.domain: Linear and structural cryptanalysis of block ciphers, focusing on trail clustering and symmetry.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Strengthen the symmetry/eigenvector equivalence or find round-independent trail clustering that does not originate from symmetries.

citations.label: On the Distribution of Linear Biases: Three Instructive Examples

progress.summary: The paper presents two directions for future work: tighten the existing equivalence or find round-independent trail clustering that does not originate from symmetries.
